memory_candidates.content: When a PR head moves mid-review and the branch was rebased/merged onto an updated base, diffing the two raw PR commits directly (old-head vs new-head) shows a huge diff dominated by whatever landed on the base in between, not the author's actual new work. Instead, fetch the new head into a fresh worktree and use `gh pr diff <N> --name-only` (or `gh pr diff <N>`) to see the PR's actual diff against its CURRENT base, which stays scoped to the files the PR itself touches; separately diff the record/doc files between the two PR commits directly (e.g. `git diff old:path new:path`) to see just the author's own wording changes.

In BimodalLogic, specs/reviews/ is excluded from git locally via .git/info/exclude (line 20). Edits there always produce a non-failure skip (exit 8 or 9) from git-commit-scoped.sh and git-commit-phase.sh when staging; this is expected repository configuration, not a staging bug or a sign the commit failed, and should be read as such rather than retried or worked around.

sapience_notes.value: Head moved mid-review from bdaa3b6d0 to a merge commit ada7074dd that rebased onto post-PR#7 main and revised the record's wording (citing milestones.md directly, tying the adapter to D4, pre-emptively adding a 'checks supplied evidence, does not search' sentence) without closing any of the three requested structural gaps: no Open Decisions section, no GO threshold, no named Until/Since/store gap.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic records/milestones.md Open decisions numbering
sapience_notes.value: Open-decision ordinals are not stable across a records rewrite. Before commit b63de1dd9, decision 4 meant 'evaluator beside the lemmas or its own mode' and decision 2 meant 'who writes the record first'. After that rewrite, decision 2 is the evaluator question, decision 4 is the signature-layer-timing question, and 'who writes first' is no longer a numbered decision at all -- it moved into milestone C2's own Channel column ('T drafts, B reviews'). Prefer citing an open decision by its question text, not its ordinal.

sapience_notes.value: Despite PR #7 merging and PR #11/#10 covering its two unconditional asks (lemmas, record), PR #9 remains open, CONFLICTING, unmoved since 2026-11-19. Recommended disposition: close with credit, salvaging FormalSystem/Metalogic/ProofModeSoundness.lean's content (not the file itself, per milestone D4's single soundness statement over TruthEnv) and ProofModeExtensionsTest.lean's scenarios as a checklist for the new mode's tests.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic FormalSystem/Tactic/FormulaSyntax.lean operator coverage
sapience_notes.value: As of PR #7 merging into main, FormulaSyntax.lean's elaboration only matches PlusFormula constructors (TM and TM-plus); it has no StarFormula (L-star) case. Any client formula in L-star is not recognized by the shared syntax table yet -- closing this is milestone D1's job (unifying the signature layer across Formula/PlusFormula/StarFormula).

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic lemmas-only control measurement (refute_allFuture_stab)
sapience_notes.value: On refute_allFuture_stab, the proof in the tree is 13 tactic lines; the tightest version written using PR #11's 52 new transport/rank-progress lemmas is also 13 lines, because exactly one lemma applies and replaces nothing (the stab elimination at the alternative history is the whole content of the refutation). This measured data point means any saving the semantic-proof-mode evaluator can show has to come from the evaluator itself, not from the lemmas library.
